build_residual_conv_block: build a ResidualConvBlock with configurable normalization, activation, and skip connection for feature extraction
build_dinov2_encoder: build a DINOv2Encoder to extract multi-scale vision features from RGB images with gradient checkpointing
build_resampler: build a Resampler module to upsample or downsample feature maps using pixel shuffle, bilinear, or conv transpose
build_conv_stack: build a ConvStack with residual blocks and resamplers for multi-scale feature processing and fusion
build_mlp: build an MLP module with configurable layer dimensions and ReLU activations for projection tasks
